title: Biostrap Sleep Debt Weekly Accumulation
dataSources: HRV (`hrv:reading`), blood oxygen (`spo2:reading`), lab panels (`bloodpanel:result`), supplements (`supplement:intake`), continuous glucose (`cgm:glucose`), sleep-apnea events (`apnea:event`), body composition (`bodycomp:measure`), blood pressure (`bloodpressure:reading`).
app: Biohacking data — HRV straps, pulse oximeters, blood-pressure cuffs, continuous glucose monitors, body-composition scales, lab-result exports, and supplement logs — ingested to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=biostrap:sleep
bin _time span=1w
stats sum(sleep_debt_min) as debt_min by user_id
description: Totals weekly Biostrap sleep debt minutes.
value: Surfacing biostrap sleep debt weekly accumulation helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant advanced health & biohacking export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out when biostrap sleep debt weekly accumulation matters for your routine.
